landing.title: Report infrastructure damage in your area
landing.description: Help UNDP analysts coordinate crisis response by documenting damaged buildings, roads, and utilities, even without an internet connection.
landing.feature_offline: Works offline. Reports sync automatically when you reconnect.
landing.feature_gps: GPS-located so responders know exactly where to go
landing.feature_anonymous: Reports are anonymous and reviewed by UNDP analysts
landing.label: Community Reporting Tool
landing.privacy_note: Data is anonymised and used solely for coordinating humanitarian response.
landing.how_subtitle: No registration needed. Anyone can report damage in under 2 minutes.
landing.step1_desc: Take a clear photo of the damaged building, road, or utility. Your phone camera is all you need.
landing.step2_desc: Share GPS coordinates or describe the location. We'll match the nearest building footprint automatically.
landing.step3_desc: Select crisis type, infrastructure, and severity. Add any urgent needs. Takes under 2 minutes.
landing.step4_desc: No internet? Reports save to your device and upload automatically the moment you reconnect.
landing.footer_tagline: Community-driven infrastructure damage reporting for sudden-onset crises.
landing.footer_rights: Open source · MIT License · UNDP InnoCentive Initiative
